RMS_guard.assumption: Driver delivered positive charge <=85mA*20ms in EVERY20ms window; healthy regulating controller. No diode reverse current or separate source. This is a proposed testable envelope, NOT proven manufacturer data.
RMS_guard.derivation: Concentrate each20ms charge at one instant into first-orderC||R discharge, a conservative impulse-burst bound; x*coth(x),x=T/(2RC). Does not infer RMS from long-termmean.
